system.description:
Allows the character to fly through an atmosphere using any method such, magic, or anti-gravity.
Level 1: Fly at speeds up to 10 kph
Level 2: Fly at speeds up to 30 kph
Level 3: Fly at speeds up to 100 kph
Level 4: Fly at speeds up to 300 kph
Level 5: Fly at speeds up to 1,000 kph
Level 6: Fly at speeds up to 3,000 kph
